meta.note: Ready-made jobs for the demo: the intake answers, the write-up the model should produce, the tier, and which price-book archetype the prices came from. Use these for testing the intake prompt, for a fallback when venue wifi blocks a photo upload, and for rehearsing the pitch. Prices are filled in by build-demo-data.mjs from the archetype, so the price book stays the single source of truth.

jobs.scenario: Burst pipe under the kitchen sink
jobs.description: Water is spraying out from under the kitchen sink, I have turned the tap off under there but there is water all over the floorboards

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: New Farm

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: ASAP, it is leaking right now

answers.prompt: What have you already turned off or unplugged?
answers.answer: The little tap under the sink. Water is still dripping but not spraying

answers.prompt: Is the water near any power points or wiring?
answers.answer: There is a power point right beside the cupboard, I turned that one off at the wall

writeUp.title: Burst flexi hose under the kitchen sink
writeUp.summary: A braided flexi hose under the kitchen sink has split and was spraying water. The customer has shut off the isolation valve and the nearby power point. Floorboards are wet and the cabinet base is soaked.

details.label: Damage
details.value: Floorboards and cabinet base wet, no visible ceiling damage

details.label: Power
details.value: Nearby power point switched off at the wall

writeUp.priceReason: Emergency same-day callout with the parts commonly needed for a split flexi hose.

jobs.scenario: Half the kitchen power points are dead
jobs.description: None of the power points along the kitchen bench are working and one of them made a popping noise earlier. The rest of the house is fine

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Teneriffe

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Today if possible, we cannot use the kettle or microwave

answers.prompt: Has a safety switch or breaker tripped?
answers.answer: One switch in the box was down, I put it back up and it did not trip again

answers.prompt: Did you see or smell anything when it happened?
answers.answer: Heard a pop from the power point next to the microwave, no smoke or smell now

writeUp.title: Kitchen power point circuit fault after a pop
writeUp.summary: Four power points on the kitchen bench circuit are dead. The customer heard a pop from the point beside the microwave and reset a tripped breaker once. There is no smoke or burning smell now, but a damaged point or loose termination is likely and should be isolated before the circuit is used again.

details.label: Breaker
details.value: Tripped once, reset by customer, not retripping

details.label: Symptom
details.value: Audible pop at one power point

details.label: Appliance
details.value: Microwave was running at the time

writeUp.priceReason: Fault finding on an unknown circuit, with the isolation and replacement of a damaged power point allowed for.

jobs.scenario: Water stain spreading on the ceiling after rain
jobs.description: There is a brown stain on the lounge room ceiling that has got bigger after the storms this week, and it feels soft when I press it

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Bulimba

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Before the next rain, so this week

answers.prompt: Is water coming through right now?
answers.answer: No dripping at the moment, it only shows up when it rains hard

answers.prompt: What is above that ceiling?
answers.answer: Single storey, tiled roof, that room is under the ridge line

writeUp.title: Roof leak staining the lounge ceiling
writeUp.summary: A ceiling stain about the size of a dinner plate has grown after recent storms and the plasterboard is soft to touch, which means it has been wet more than once. The roof above is tiled and the room sits under the ridge line, so ridge capping or flashing is the likely entry point.

details.label: Ceiling condition
details.value: Soft when pressed, needs inspection from above

writeUp.priceReason: Roof inspection and leak repair on a tiled roof, priced for a same-week visit.

jobs.scenario: Locked out, keys on the kitchen bench
jobs.description: I have locked myself out, the keys are on the kitchen bench and I can see them through the window. It is a deadlock and a normal handle lock

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Ashgrove

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Right now, I have my daughter with me

answers.prompt: Is the door a deadlock, a handle lock or both?
answers.answer: Both, deadlock on top

answers.prompt: Do you have any ID showing that address?
answers.answer: Yes, my licence has the address

writeUp.title: Locked out of the house, deadlocked front door
writeUp.summary: The customer is locked out with a child, keys visible inside on the kitchen bench. The front door has a deadlock above a standard handle lock. Photo ID with the address is available for verification.

details.label: Door
details.value: Timber front door, deadlock plus handle lock

details.label: Keys
details.value: Visible inside, not in the lock

writeUp.priceReason: After-hours lockout attendance, non-destructive entry where the lock allows it.

jobs.scenario: Dishwasher leaves water in the bottom
jobs.description: The dishwasher finishes its cycle but there is a couple of centimetres of dirty water sitting in the bottom of it

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Coorparoo

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: No rush, sometime next week

answers.prompt: What brand and roughly how old is it?
answers.answer: Bosch, about six years old

answers.prompt: Have you checked the filter?
answers.answer: Yes, took the filter out and cleaned it, still does it

writeUp.title: Dishwasher not draining after the cycle
writeUp.summary: A six year old Bosch dishwasher is leaving a few centimetres of dirty water in the tub at the end of the cycle. The customer has already cleaned the filter, so the drain pump or the outlet hose is the likely cause.

details.label: Access
details.value: Freestanding under bench, side access available

writeUp.priceReason: Standard appliance callout with the drain pump and hose check included in the first hour.

jobs.scenario: Two fence panels down after wind
jobs.description: The wind took out two panels of our timber fence last night, the palings are on the ground and one post looks loose

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Wynnum

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: This week, the dog keeps getting out

answers.prompt: How long is the damaged section?
answers.answer: About three metres, two panels

answers.prompt: Is the fence on a boundary with a neighbour?
answers.answer: Yes, shared with next door but they are fine with us organising it

writeUp.title: Storm damaged timber fence, two panels
writeUp.summary: Two panels of a timber paling fence are down after wind, about three metres, with one post loose. It is a shared boundary and the neighbour has agreed to the repair. The dog is getting out, so a temporary barrier is worth doing on the first visit.

details.label: Post
details.value: One post loose, may need re-setting

writeUp.priceReason: Replacing two panels and re-setting one post, including removal of the damaged timber.

jobs.scenario: Hole in the hallway wall from a door handle
jobs.description: There is a hole in the plasterboard behind the bedroom door where the handle has hit it, about the size of my fist

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Indooroopilly

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Whenever suits, we are not in a hurry

answers.prompt: Do you want it painted as well?
answers.answer: Just patched and sanded is fine, we will paint the hallway later

answers.prompt: Is it a rental?
answers.answer: No, our own place

writeUp.title: Fist-sized hole in plasterboard behind a door
writeUp.summary: A hole about 100 mm across in the plasterboard behind a bedroom door, caused by the door handle. The customer wants it patched and sanded to a paint-ready finish, not painted. No structural concern, it is an internal wall.
writeUp.priceReason: Single patch repair with taping, setting and sanding, no painting.

jobs.scenario: Hot water died on a Friday night
jobs.description: No hot water since this afternoon, the unit outside is an electric one and there is water around the base of it

answers.prompt: Which suburb is the job in?
answers.answer: Kelvin Grove

answers.prompt: How soon do you need it?
answers.answer: Tomorrow morning if we can, we have family staying

answers.prompt: How old is the hot water system?
answers.answer: About twelve years, it came with the house

answers.prompt: Is water pooling or running?
answers.answer: Just a wet patch around the base, not running

writeUp.title: Electric hot water system failed, water at the base
writeUp.summary: An electric hot water system about twelve years old has stopped heating and there is a wet patch around its base, which usually means the tank has gone. At that age a replacement is more likely than a repair, so the visit should confirm the tank condition and quote a like-for-like swap.

details.label: Symptom
details.value: No hot water, wet patch at the base

details.label: Access
details.value: External side of house, clear access

writeUp.priceReason: Like-for-like electric storage replacement including removal of the old unit, priced for a next-day visit.
